This partnership evidences TAO Group’s continued aggressive growth strategy in Mexico and beyond following multiple openings in 2018 including Los Cabos, Mexico and overseas in Bali, Indonesia.

Tao Group Hospitality delivers distinctive culinary and premium entertainment experiences through its portfolio of restaurants, nightclubs, lounges, and daylife venues. Tao Group Hospitality acquired Hakkasan Group in April 2021. The combined company operates more than 60 entertainment dining and nightlife venues in over 20 markets across five continents and features a collection of widely recognized hospitality brands.
